notes.title: 🎉 Global Launch: Wise in the Heights is now on Steam!!
notes.notes:
[p][/p][h1]🚀 Global Launch[/h1][p]Hello, climbers![/p][p]After a year of 3 a.m. coffees and impossible bug hunts, [b]Wise in the Heights[/b] finally reaches the summit of Steam.[/p][h2]🕹️ What is it?[/h2][list][*][p]2D puzzle-platformer with a climbing twist[/p][/*][*][p]Hand-crafted pixel art[/p][/*][*][p]1–2 h of tight jumps gameplay[/p][/*][*][p]100 % solo-dev project from Asturias, Spain (that’s me!)[/p][/*][/list][h2]💡 Why play it?[/h2][list][*][p]If you enjoy precision platforming mixed with puzzling routes, you’ll feel right at home.[/p][/*][*][p]Polished controls ✅ Relaxing original soundtrack ✅[/p][/*][*][p]Costs about the price of a latte ☕[/p][/*][/list][h2]🎯 How you can help[/h2][olist][*][p][b]Download / Wishlist[/b] the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Play it and drop your thoughts in a review.[/p][/*][*][p]Share this event with your adventure-loving friends.[/p][/*][/olist][p]🔗 [b]Play / Wishlist here:[/b]
[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3860020/Wise_in_the_Heights/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]See you at the summit![/p][p]— [i]Noel[/i][/p]
